integrity: The general graph-theoretic vertex-cover theorem and standard generalized-quadrangle axioms are explicitly credited. Computational verification scripts are included in full and their finite scope is stated. No unperformed external audit is represented as completed.

title: Exact strong-resolving polynomials and sharp basis exchange in finite generalized quadrangles
